blogs.title: What Is Switchgear?
blogs.author: Pinnacle Power & Controls
blogs.excerpt: A practical overview of switchgear, where it is used, and what industrial buyers should review before requesting pricing.
blogs.content:
Switchgear is electrical distribution equipment used to control, protect, and isolate power systems.

For industrial facilities, switchgear helps route power safely from transformers and utility service equipment to downstream loads such as MCCs, panels, process equipment, and building systems.

When requesting switchgear pricing, provide the one-line diagram, voltage, amperage, available fault current, utility requirements, and any project specifications. %COMPANY% can review the scope and help prepare a budgetary or formal quote.
blogs.meta_description: Learn what switchgear is and what information is needed to request pricing for industrial switchgear projects.
